x: Baulch especially was in fine fettle to finish 11th behind such names as Firth, Caulder, Barrett, Towl, Maynard, Clark and Driver, all of whom are in international class in one sphere or another.

At 15 miles Norris, running splendidly, was 2mins clear of Llewellyn who in turn was 1¼mins ahead of Pawsey(Mitcham) and Towl (HHH). Linstead was maintaining his pace well and had advanced to sixth, a further 1¾mins back.

Towl (HHH) was a comfortable winner in 29:53, with Shippen (31:30), Miller (31:35) and Masters (31:40), 3rd, 4th, 5th, Charlie Dabbs (34:40) could not overcome the going and finished an uncharacteristic 15th.
